{{PAGENAME}} the engineer is found in the far northwestern part of [[Village|The Village]] and north of the [[Beekeeper]]. During the day, he is outside and sells stones and stone products to you. At night he goes inside and is unavailable without {{Happiness}}80.
He's the brother of [[Tress]], the carpenter.

==Stranger Sins==
===Quests===
Cory and [[Tress]] need to help you build your [[Tavern]] after buying the land from [[Horadric]] for {{Money|3000}}. Speaking to Cory he will tell you they need to build a barn first. You can choose to either pay him ({{Money|20000}}) or supply him the materials (12 {{Item|Simple iron parts}}, 12 {{Item|Wooden plank}}, 12 {{Item|Nails}} and {{Money|5000}}) to finish working on the barn and get to building your [[Tavern]]. Go to sleep to let the brothers finish the [[Tavern]] for you. You'll receive the [[Achievements|Talking Skull]] achievement.
